title: Asymptotic analysis of higher-order perturbations of the Perona--Malik functional
summary: The Gamma-limit of higher-order singular perturbations of the Perona-Malik functional is analyzed. The energies considered combine the critically scaled logarithmic term with a k-th order regularization designed to balance bulk and interfacial effects. A compactness result is obtained, and the Gamma-limit is identified as a free-discontinuity functional on SBV, given by the sum of the Dirichlet energy and a surface term proportional to the jump amplitude to the power 1/k.
